fusions.name: Split Point
fusions.desc: Points two fingers and fires a bolt that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of the damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Two-Tine Thrust
fusions.desc: Drives two stiff fingers forward as prongs, dealing 12 damage to everything in a narrow cone 4 tiles long and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be turned back on its source instead.

fusions.name: Either Way
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
